propositions: macOS N=3000 import benchmark test executes in 18–23s with outliers to 29s, attributed 13.69s to required real Git add/commit operations.
Locked test contract requires exactly 3,000 tickets, 3,000 comments, 6,000 events, 24 crash-safe import commits, >=10x commit reduction, and crash-resume capability.
Profiling shows 24 real Git boundaries are non-redundant and required by durability and rollback semantics; RAM-disk storage lever was measured 5.5–20% slower and reverted.
No maintained OSS consensus exists for replacing real Git semantics with library-only metadata reads or weakening commit boundaries without loss of fidelity.
Test remains below 30s on all platforms and is not the hosted critical path; no fidelity-preserving optimization candidate exists to justify remediation.
